compression_level.description: Compression level, 0 (fastest) to 9 (best compression). Default is 6.

threads.description: Number of (de)compression threads. Defaults to number of processors.

dict_size.description: Dictionary size limit in bytes. 12-29 are powers of 2. 23 is 2^23 = 8 MiB.

match_length.description: Match length limit in bytes. Default is 36.

in_slots.description: Number of 1 MiB input packets buffered. Default is 4.

out_slots.description: Number of 1 MiB output packets buffered. Default is 64.

keep_input.description: If true, keep input files after compression (-k/--keep).

force.description: If true, force overwrite of existing output files (-f/--force).

trailing_error.description: If true, exit with error if trailing data is present (-a/--trailing-error).
